description: Start a video-clipping job. Ask the user for aspect_ratio and caption_style if they're not given. If the user says 'just pick,' default to aspect_ratio '9:16' and caption_style 'minimalist'. Videos must be 2–180 minutes long. Jobs take 10–30 minutes; Vugola will email the user when done, and the agent can check status via get_clip_status.
name: clip_video
